args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 10 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## ⭐⭐⭐ ENGINEERING CHANGE SPECIFICATIONS RETRIEVAL
- **siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1** - BEST FOR ENGINEERING CHANGE SPECS: Automates engineering change processing; coordinates changes across product items and materials; synchronizes configuration updates; related entity types: EngineeringChange, Material, ProductItem; capabilities: coordinate-bom-updates, synchronize-engineering-changes, evaluate-change-impact, track-change-status, manage-material-provisioning; ensures manufacturing teams have current specifications

## ⭐⭐⭐ CUSTOMER SAFETY COMPLIANCE VERIFICATION
- **sap.ehs:agent:ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator:v1** - BEST FOR CUSTOMER SAFETY COMPLIANCE: Automates safety compliance campaigns across customer segments and accounts; monitors campaign effectiveness; coordinates regulatory compliance initiatives; orchestrates targeted safety interventions based on customer account risk profiles; related entity types: Campaign, CustomerAccount, CustomerSegment

## ⭐⭐⭐ EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE SAFETY RISK ANALYSIS
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1** - BEST FOR EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE SAFETY: Coordinates safety incident workflows & emergency response; related entity types: ChangeRequest, ITEquipment, ServiceTicket

## ⭐⭐⭐ PROCUREMENT INVOICE RECONCILIATION (VENDOR INVOICES ONLY)
- **sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1** - Matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts; three-way matching logic; validates line-item quantities, pricing, terms; flags exceptions (overbilling, duplicates, policy violations)
- **sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceInvoiceAutomation:v1** - Validates supplier invoices against POs & contracts; detects billing anomalies, overages; related entity types: Contract, PurchaseOrder, Vendor

## ⭐⭐⭐ PRODUCT LAUNCH WORKFORCE PROCESS
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - BEST FOR PRODUCT LAUNCH CAMPAIGN PROVISIONING: Automates product change coordination and inventory synchronization; triggers coordinated customer engagement campaigns; orchestrates targeted sales communications to affected customer segments; processes product item transitions through lifecycle stages

## ⭐⭐⭐ PRODUCT LAUNCH SUPPLIER QUALIFICATION
- **siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1** - BEST FOR MATERIAL & VENDOR QUALIFICATION: Coordinates supplier qualification processes and material approval workflows; validates materials against engineering specs; monitors vendor compliance; manages material-to-vendor mappings; ensures supply chain quality for production transition

## ⭐⭐ INCIDENT ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Analyzes safety incidents for root causes; generates RCA reports; related entity types: SafetyIncident, Incident, HazardousSubstance

## GAPS IDENTIFIED
- NO resource for "SafetyComplianceCostReconciliation" - combining safety/compliance costs with customer invoices and material usage
- NO resource for "ComplianceFinancialImpactAnalysis" - quantifying financial impact of safety activities vs revenue
- Invoice reconciliation agents focus on vendor-to-PO matching, not cost-to-revenue matching for compliance activities
